newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS SHARES SLUMP ON EARNINGS DOWNGRADE.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS SHARES SLUMP ON EARNINGS DOWNGRADE.

text.p: Shares of Philips Electronics NV fell almost four guilders on Monday immediately after the company said it no longer expected an improvement in operating profits in the second half of this year.
In the first few minutes of trading on the Amsterdam bourse Philips shares were off 3.70 guilders at 61.10 after hitting an early low of 60.40.
